subject: [PATCH 42/60] mm: fail private placement on exhaustion instead of OOM killing

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to improve handling of private memory allocation failures by introducing a new flag and modifying relevant functions. The approach is based on the understanding that private memory pools are fixed and should not trigger OOM killing.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses private memory allocation issues in the Linux kernel, specifically focusing on handling exhaustion of private memory pools instead of relying on the OOM killer. The approach involves introducing a new flag to track failed private allocations and modifying various functions to handle this scenario correctly.
